name: I-765 Work Permit (EAD)
summary: Initial or renewal employment authorization in the category the client qualifies for.
instructionsNote: I-765 instructions were not in the reference set yet. Add i-765instr.pdf to reference/ and re-check this checklist and the category list.

filing.where: See 'Where To File' on uscis.gov/i-765 (depends on eligibility category). Many categories can file online.
filing.fee: See Form G-1055 at uscis.gov/g-1055. The fee depends on category.

Front and back of your current or previous work permit

coverLetter.re: Form I-765, Application for Employment Authorization - category {{eligibilityCategory}}
coverLetter.request: We respectfully submit the enclosed Form I-765 on behalf of {{givenName}} {{familyName}}, requesting {{requestType}} employment authorization under category {{eligibilityCategory}}.
points: The applicant is eligible under the stated category, as shown by the enclosed receipt or approval notice ({{categoryReceipt}}).
